_comment: Player polls (V): what should the game focus on? Each poll is opened on-chain (contracts/src/Polls.sol) the first time it is listed; players vote with a signature (no gas), one vote each, and get a reward. The last option can be a free answer. Results feed SYSTEM's follow-up (agents/README.md), V keeps a veto on-chain. Each poll states its estimated impact on the blockchain (`chain`): the vote reward scales with it (impact_multipliers), and once the work is done an admin marks the poll useful (follow_up_levels): every voter gets the poll's follow-up reward, scaled the same way, in their reward box. PLACEHOLDER questions.

polls.question: Sur quoi The Seed doit-il se concentrer en premier ?

chain.note: PvP and guild raids touch the Roles and Marketplace contracts (an upgrade of existing proxies).

polls.question: Quel événement veux-tu pour le prochain week-end ?

chain.note: A weekend event is off-chain game data.
